final_message:
Partial refunds are fixed. `npm test` now passes all 20 tests, including `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`.

The cause was in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`. The function documents `percent` as 0–100, but it multiplied the amount by `percent` directly. A 50% refund on 1250 came out as 62500 instead of 625. The fix divides by 100 before rounding:

```js
amount: Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100) });
```

Nothing else in the repo calls `partialRefund`, so the change is limited to that one line. I didn't commit anything.
